Sandbox_PlayableTennis_FitnessXPMultipli: Multiplies the base 20 XP per minute of active rallies. 1 = default, 0 = no tennis Fitness XP. Native XP modifiers also apply.
Sandbox_PlayableTennis_NimbleXPMultiplie: Multiplies the base 3 XP per minute of active rallies. 1 = default, 0 = no tennis Nimble XP. Native XP modifiers also apply.
